contracts.signal: Voluntary disclosure: sale of semiconductor FOUP cleaner equipment to SK Hynix (memory semiconductor maker; relationship: customer; ISTE has performed same-type contracts with it in the past three years). Signed 10-06-2026; term 10-06-2026 to 05-31-2027, the end date reflecting expected payment after the final delivery scheduled for December 2026; no advance payment, 90% paid on delivery and 10% after acceptance; in-house and outsourced production; supply region Korea. Amount and terms may change as the contract progresses.
